The official recursive Git tree at that revision was complete (`truncated=false`). It contains the root LICENSE and no separate LICENSE/COPYING/NOTICE in the show-me source ancestry or subtree. Retaining the complete HumanLayer MIT copyright/grant alongside Matt's original MIT license and unchanged credits addresses this identified attribution requirement.

This revision verifies the named material and current explicit grant. It is not presented as the unknown historical revision originally copied by Matt. This notice adds provenance and preserves original license distinctions. It does not relicense the SettleTable application or modify the vendored skill files.
